### Priority list
1. **`#main`** (h1 + 3 testimonial cards, ~1264×246px, area 311497) — this is effectively the entire visible page; getting its overall layout/spacing right dominates fidelity.
2. **`div.testimonial-card` (×3)** — repeated card structure (img + quote text) each ~1264×52px; the largest chunk of visible content/text on the page.
3. **`h1` "What people say"** — largest single text element (37px tall, full width), sets the page's typographic tone.

The raw HTML shows this page has **no linked stylesheet and no inline styles at all** — just semantic markup relying entirely on the browser's default UA stylesheet. Before assuming "no CSS" means "nothing to check," I'll confirm actual computed values (font, color, spacing) with windtailor rather than guessing browser defaults, since guessing here is exactly the failure mode the instructions warn about.

events.text:
The clone is a pixel-perfect match — odiff reported 0 differing pixels (exit code 0) on the first round, so no further iteration was needed.

**Summary of decisions:**

- **Investigated first, before assuming anything:** crow-nester's outline showed only 8 notable nodes — an `h1` and three `div.testimonial-card` blocks (each with an `img` + `p`) inside `#main`. Raw HTML confirmed the page has **no linked stylesheet and no inline styles at all** — it relies entirely on the browser's default UA stylesheet.
- **windtailor check on `body`** confirmed there was nothing to extract beyond default browser rendering (h1 at 32px/700 weight is just the UA default; everything else was plain `display: block` with no authored colors, spacing, or fonts). This ruled out the risk of guessing a fake design system for a page that has none.
- **Componentization:** the three `testimonial-card` divs are structurally identical (avatar image + quote paragraph), but I didn't need red-twine here since there was no CSS-driven styling to reconcile — I kept them as plain semantic markup exactly as authored, since that markup *is* the entire visual design.
- **No Tailwind config was introduced.** Since the source page has zero authored CSS, layering Tailwind's CDN build (which includes a preflight/reset that strips default margins and font sizes) would have actively broken fidelity rather than helped it. The highest-fidelity clone here was a faithful, self-contained copy of the same semantic HTML.
- **Images:** left as the original relative paths (`/avatar-1.jpg`, etc.) since this is a local fixture with no live origin to hotlink against — this reproduces the same (broken-image) rendering as the source rather than inventing a fake asset host.
- **Nothing was flagged as unrecreatable** — the page is fully static, semantic markup with no JS-gated content, canvases, or cross-origin embeds.
- **Fidelity check:** screenshots at the shared 1280×900 viewport (`original.png`, `clone-round1.png`) diffed with odiff to `diff-round1.png` — result was `0;0` differing pixels, exit code 0 (match), so one round was sufficient.

All screenshots (`original.png`, `clone-round1.png`, `diff-round1.png`) are saved in `/var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-h51HbT`, and the final clone is at `/var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-h51HbT/clone.html`.
